keyword_glossary.Channel: Channeling an Orb puts it into your first empty slot. If you have no empty slots, your first Orb is automatically Evoked to make room.
keyword_glossary.Covered: An ally is covering you. All attacks that would be directed to you are redirected to them instead.
keyword_glossary.Dark: A type of Orb. Passive: Increase damage by 6 (+ Focus) Evoke: Deal stored damage to the enemy with the least HP.
keyword_glossary.Debuff: A negative status on a creature (Weak, Vulnerable, Poison, Doom ...); Artifact negates one.
keyword_glossary.Dexterity: Increases Block gained from cards by X.
keyword_glossary.Dexterity (Negative): Lose X Dexterity: Block gained from cards is X lower.
keyword_glossary.Discard: Put a card from your hand into the discard pile without playing it.
keyword_glossary.Doom: At the end of the enemy turn, if it has X or less HP, it dies.
keyword_glossary.Double Damage: For the next X turns, Attacks deal double damage.
keyword_glossary.Draw: Move cards from the top of your draw pile into your hand (the discard pile is reshuffled into it when it runs out).
keyword_glossary.Draw Cards Next Turn: At the start of your next turn, draw X additional cards.
keyword_glossary.Draw Next Turn: At the start of your next turn, draw X additional cards.
keyword_glossary.Enchant: Add an Enchantment to a card in your Deck
keyword_glossary.Energy: Energy is used to play cards from your Hand.
keyword_glossary.Eternal: Cannot be removed or transformed from your Deck.
keyword_glossary.Ethereal: If an Ethereal card is in your hand at the end of your turn, it is Exhausted.
keyword_glossary.Evoke: Consume your rightmost Orb and use its Evoke effect.
keyword_glossary.Exhaust: Removed until the end of combat.
keyword_glossary.Fatal: Triggers when this card kills a non-minion enemy.
keyword_glossary.Focus: Increases the effectiveness of Orbs by X.
keyword_glossary.Forge: The first time you Forge each combat, add Sovereign Blade into your Hand. Adds additional damage to Sovereign Blade.
keyword_glossary.Frail: Gain 25% less Block from cards for X turns.
keyword_glossary.Free Power: The next X Powers you play cost 0 [E].
keyword_glossary.Free Skill: The next X Skills you play cost 0 [E].
keyword_glossary.Frost: A type of Orb. Passive: Gain 2 (+ Focus) Block Evoke: Gain 5 (+ Focus) Block
keyword_glossary.Glass: A type of Orb. Passive: Deal 4 (+ Focus) to ALL enemies. Decrease damage by 1. Evoke: Deal damage equal to double its passive damage to ALL enemies.
keyword_glossary.Gold: Run currency, spent at the Merchant.
keyword_glossary.Guarded: Take half damage from enemies. Removed if the Tank dies.
keyword_glossary.Heal: Restore HP, up to your Max HP.
keyword_glossary.Improvement: At the end of combat, Upgrade X random cards.
keyword_glossary.Innate: Start each combat with this card in your hand.
keyword_glossary.Intangible: Reduce all damage taken and HP loss to 1. Lasts for X turns.
keyword_glossary.Lightning: A Type of Orb. Passive: Deal 3 (+ Focus) damage to a random enemy. Evoke: Deals 8 (+ Focus) damage to a random enemy.
keyword_glossary.Lose HP: Lose HP directly; Block does not prevent it (self-damage costs, or damage that skips Block).
keyword_glossary.Monarch's Gaze Strength Down: Lose X Strength until the end of this turn.
keyword_glossary.Next Turn Block: At the start of your next turn, gain X Block.
keyword_glossary.No Block: You cannot gain Block from cards for X turns.
keyword_glossary.No Draw: You may not draw any more cards this turn.
keyword_glossary.Orb: Defect resource: Channel puts an Orb into an Orb slot; each Orb has a passive effect every turn and a stronger one-shot Evoke effect when pushed out or evoked. Focus boosts both.
keyword_glossary.Osty: Necrobinder's companion (her skeletal left hand). While alive he absorbs unblocked attack damage for her (Die for You); some cards make Osty attack. His damage ignores Strength/Weak.
keyword_glossary.Plasma: A type of Orb. Passive: Gain 1 [E] Energy. Evoke: Gain 2 [E] Energy.
keyword_glossary.Plating: At the end of your turn, gain X Block. Plating is reduced by 1 at the start of your turn.
keyword_glossary.Poison: At the start of its turn, loses X HP, then reduce Poison by 1.
keyword_glossary.Replay: Plays this card an additional time.
keyword_glossary.Retain: Retained cards are not discarded at the end of turn.
keyword_glossary.Retain Hand: Retain your Hand for the next X turns.
keyword_glossary.Sandpit: In X turns, you will be eaten and die.
keyword_glossary.Shiv: Generated Attack card (cost 0): Deal 4 damage. Exhaust.
keyword_glossary.Sly: If this card is discarded from your Hand before the end of the turn, play it for free.
keyword_glossary.Star: Regent's second resource ([Star]): gained from cards/relics, not refilled each turn, carried over between turns; some cards cost Stars in addition to Energy.
keyword_glossary.Strangle: Whenever you play a card this turn, this enemy loses X HP.
keyword_glossary.Strength (Negative): Lose X Strength (enemy or self): attacks deal X less damage.
keyword_glossary.Stunned: This enemy can't act on its next turn.
keyword_glossary.Summon: Summon Osty with X HP. If already summoned, raise his Max HP by X for this combat.
keyword_glossary.Summon Next Turn: At the start of your next turn, Summon X.
keyword_glossary.Thorns: When hit by an attack, deal X damage back.
keyword_glossary.Transform: Transformed cards become a random card of any rarity, unless specified.
keyword_glossary.Unplayable: Cannot be played from your Hand.
keyword_glossary.Upgrade: Upgrading cards makes them more powerful. Cards can only be upgraded once.
keyword_glossary.Vigor: Your next Attack deals X additional damage.
keyword_glossary.Vulnerable: Receive 50% more damage from Attacks for X turns.
keyword_glossary.Weak: Attacks deal 25% less damage for X turns.
